notes.title: New language version - German ...and Spanish, Russian, Chinese - Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9753216/710e962f2f72b5936d74191b44ab5144aabda6b9.jpg[/img]

Hi, 
Our game Tsioque is going live tomorrow.  We are pleased to announce that - apart from [b]English[/b] and [b]Polish[/b] - Tsioque will also premiere featuring a [b]GERMAN[/b] language version.

We are also working on [b]Spanish, Russian and Chinese[/b] language versions, which should become available shortly after the premiere.
Sincerely,

[i]Ohnoo Studio & Smile[/i]
